summary: Tested Emergent Google sign-in gating of the contractor dashboard. Backend: new test_auth_google.py (24 tests) + conftest.py (Mongo-created sessions); updated both existing suites to send Bearer token. 51/51 pass (serial -n 0 and default -n 2). Verified: 11 protected endpoints + /auth/me -> 401 without auth; bogus Bearer 401; expired session 401 'Session expired'; public /health, /portal/demo-luis, /vapi/tools (200), /payments/status/x (404); /auth/me via Bearer and cookie returns exactly user_id/email/name/picture; non-allow-listed user -> 403 on /auth/me, /dashboard, /dev/config; /auth/session bogus id -> 401, missing body 422; logout deletes session from DB + Max-Age=0 cookie, token then 401; checkout with mismatched Origin -> 400. Frontend: / and /dev show login screen without cookie; google-signin-btn goes to auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https://walkthru.../ ; with cookie dashboard loads, sidebar shows divi@velvee.ai + Sign out; Sign out -> login screen, cookie gone, reload stays on login; outsider cookie -> login with 'This account doesn't have access'. /dev create TEST_ lead + advance works; dashboard Start agent on Dana Kim works (simulated SMS toast). Portal /w/demo-luis at 390px loads with no login, mock call starts with Alex caption; /w/demo-ana Pay deposit redirects to checkout.stripe.com. FOUND: (1) cancel toast regression (fixed by tester), (2) RequireAuth trusts stale history state user (reported).

minor.issue: Origin check only applies when an Origin header is sent; a non-browser client omitting Origin can still pass any origin_url (e.g. https://evil.example.com -> 200) so the open-redirect via success/cancel URL remains. Validate origin_url against PUBLIC_APP_URL instead.
Cookie takes precedence over Bearer: a stale/invalid session_token cookie causes 401 even when a valid Bearer header is sent. Consider falling back to Bearer if cookie session not found.
Still has hardcoded fallback stripe.api_key 'sk_test_emergent' (flagged in iteration_3).

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION, FIXED BY TESTER: <Toaster> was placed after <Routes> again (undoing iteration_3 fix), so 'Payment cancelled' toast on /w/{token}?payment=cancelled never showed. Moved Toaster above Routes; verified toast now shows top-center at 390px.

Initial user is taken from location.state.user (set by AuthCallback navigate). React Router persists this in window.history.state, so after a sign-in -> Sign out -> page reload (or Back), or whenever history.state.usr.user exists, the dashboard shell + signed-in email + Sign out render with NO valid session, and only 'Couldn't load leads' toasts appear. Reproduced by setting history.state {usr:{user:{...}}} without cookie and reloading. Fix: always verify with GET /auth/me (use state.user only as optimistic placeholder), and clear state on sign-out (navigate(pathname,{replace:true,state:null})).

integration_issues.issue: DashboardPage polling swallows errors; on 401/403 the user stays on a stale dashboard instead of being sent to the login screen. Add an axios interceptor or handle 401 in load() to reset auth.

issues: Under React.StrictMode the 'Payment cancelled' and 'Couldn't load leads' toasts appear twice (unguarded mount effects). Harmless in prod build; guard with a ref or toast id if desired.

action_items: Fix RequireAuth to not trust persisted location.state.user; verify via /auth/me and clear router state on sign-out
Redirect to login screen when dashboard API calls return 401/403 (expired session)
Validate checkout origin_url against PUBLIC_APP_URL regardless of Origin header
Keep <Toaster> before <Routes> in App.js (do not revert again)
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx:48-49 initial user/checked from location.state bypasses server verification (stale history state)
auth/routes.py require_user: cookie-first token lookup ignores valid Bearer when cookie is stale
auth/routes.py create_session uses requests in to_thread - fine; allow-list check before user/session creation - good; 403 message leaks nothing sensitive
dashboard router-level Depends(require_user) correctly covers all /api dashboard + dev routes; portal/vapi/payments/stripe webhook stay public - correct

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (cancel-toast regression fixed by tester; stale-state auth bypass open)

test_credentials: No passwords. Sessions created directly in Mongo for divi@velvee.ai per /app/auth_testing.md; all test sessions and test users deleted afterwards (users and user_sessions collections empty).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI Lead via /dev; Dana Kim invited via Start agent; POST /api/dev/reset (authenticated) called at end, sample data reseeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py creates a divi@velvee.ai user if missing and a test_session_<hex> token; tests send it as Bearer. Browser: add cookie session_token (domain walkthru.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, SameSite=None). To reproduce stale-state bug: on / without cookie run history.replaceState({usr:{user:{email:'x'}},key:'a',idx:0},'') then reload. Note users collection is empty after cleanup, so the real owner's first Google login will create the user fresh.
rca of the issue: Cancel toast: App.js rendered <Toaster> after <Routes>; sonner only delivers to already-subscribed toasters, so PortalPage's mount-effect toast fired before Toaster subscribed. Fix: render Toaster first (applied, verified). Stale auth: RequireAuth seeds user/checked from location.state which React Router stores in history.state (survives reloads); signOut only clears component state, so reload re-reads the old user and skips /auth/me.
